ValidationRule.description: Upon completing Onsite Visits, the Meeting Date is required (if performed). Please specify the date the meeting occurred.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c,"Sustainability - Onsite Visit") && ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"Completed") && !ISPICKVAL(Meeting_Type__c,"Not Performed") && !ISPICKVAL(Meeting_Type__c,"") && ISBLANK(Meeting_Date__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Upon completing Onsite Visits, the Meeting Date is required (if performed). Please specify the date the meeting occurred.
